name: Pushups
steps: Set your hands just wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line and squeeze your stomach.
Lower your chest towards the floor with control.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Flaring your elbows straight out to the sides

name: Incline Push-Up
steps: Put your hands on a bench or sturdy raised surface.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge with control.
Push back up without moving your hips.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench with your feet flat and a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them slowly until your elbows are just below the bench.
Press up and slightly together.
mistakes: Bouncing the weights at the bottom
Lifting your hips off the bench

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set the bench to a low incline.
Hold the dumbbells at upper-chest height.
Press up until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly back to the start.

name: Dumbbell Flyes
steps: Lie back with the dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms wide until you feel a gentle stretch.
Bring the weights back together in the same arc.

name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
steps: Lie with your eyes under the bar and feet flat.
Grip just wider than your shoulders and unrack the bar.
Lower it to your mid-chest with control.
Press it back over your shoulders.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off your chest

name: Machine Bench Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Press forward without locking your elbows hard.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Crossover
steps: Set both pulleys high and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Bring your hands together in a wide arc.
Open back up slowly.

name: Standing Cable Chest Press
steps: Set the handles at chest height and step forward.
Stand in a split stance with your stomach tight.
Press your hands forward.
Return slowly.

name: Bench Press - With Bands
steps: Anchor the band under the bench or around your back.
Lie down holding the band at chest height.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with your thighs under the pad and grip wide.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind your neck

name: Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with your thighs under the pad and grip the bar just inside your shoulders.
Lift your chest.
Pull to your upper chest, leading with your elbows.
Return slowly.

name: Underhand Cable Pulldowns
steps: Hold the bar with palms facing you at shoulder width.
Lift your chest and tighten your stomach.
Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Straighten your arms slowly.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Stand facing a high pulley and hold the bar at arm's length.
Hinge forward slightly.
Keep your arms long and press the bar to your thighs.
Raise it slowly.

name: Pullups
steps: Hang from the bar with hands just wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulders down.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way with control.

name: Chin-Up
steps: Hang with your palms facing you.
Tighten your stomach.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Cable Rows
steps: Sit tall with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle to your stomach.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Reach forward slowly.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Put one hand and knee on the bench.
Keep your back flat and hold the dumbbell below your shoulder.
Pull it towards your hip.
Lower slowly.

name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row
steps: Hold two dumbbells and hinge at your hips.
Keep your back flat.
Pull the weights towards your ribs.
Lower slowly.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
steps: Hold the bar and hinge at your hips with a flat back.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower it with control.
mistakes: Using your hips to swing the bar

name: Back Flyes - With Bands
steps: Hold the band with both hands in front of your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull your hands apart.
Return slowly.

name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with your arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs a little off the floor.
Hold for a moment and squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Incline Row
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Let the dumbbells hang.
Pull them towards your ribs.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Tighten your stomach.
Press up until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Bringing the weights too low too fast

name: Standing Military Press
steps: Hold the bar at your upper chest.
Squeeze your stomach and glutes.
Press straight up, moving your head back slightly.
Lower with control.

name: Leverage Shoulder Press
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Sit tall against the pad.
Press up without locking hard.
Lower slowly.

name: Side Lateral Raise
steps: Stand with light dumbbells at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Front Dumbbell Raise
steps: Hold light dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise them to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Flyes
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back.
Let light dumbbells hang.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Lower slowly.

name: Face Pull
steps: Set a rope at face height.
Step back and hold the ends.
Pull towards your forehead with elbows high.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Seated Lateral Raise
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley.
Hold the handle across your body.
Raise your arm to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Shoulder Press - With Bands
steps: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold it at shoulder height.
Press up.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Letting the band pull you forward

name: Lateral Raise - With Bands
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends.
Raise your arms to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Using a band that is too heavy

name: Band Pull Apart
steps: Hold the band at chest height.
Keep your arms straight.
Pull your hands out to the sides.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Keep your elbows by your ribs.
Curl the weights up.
Lower slowly.

name: Hammer Curls
steps: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows still.
Curl up.
Lower slowly.

name: Barbell Curl
steps: Hold the bar at shoulder width, palms forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Biceps Cable Curl
steps: Stand facing a low pulley.
Hold the bar with palms up.
Curl up without moving your elbows.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Letting the weight pull your arms straight fast

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Sit back on an incline bench.
Let your arms hang.
Curl the weights up.
Lower slowly.

name: Concentration Curls
steps: Sit with your elbow against your inner thigh.
Let the dumbbell hang.
Curl it up.
Lower slowly.

name: Triceps Pushdown
steps: Stand facing a high pulley and hold the bar.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Push down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.

name: Bench Dips
steps: Put your hands on the edge of a bench behind you.
Walk your feet forward.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Press back up.

name: Seated Triceps Press
steps: Sit tall and hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
steps: Grip the bar at shoulder width.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Lower to your lower chest.
Press up.

name: Incline Push-Up Close-Grip
steps: Put your hands close together on a raised surface.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest with elbows close.
Press back up.

name: Band Skull Crusher
steps: Lie down with the band anchored behind your head.
Hold your hands above your chest.
Bend at the elbows.
Straighten your arms.

name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Stand up tall.

name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell at your chest.
Sit down between your hips with your chest up.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Stand up through your whole foot.

name: Dumbbell Squat
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Sit your hips down and back.
Keep your chest up.
Stand up.

name: Barbell Squat
steps: Use a squat rack and rest the bar on your upper back.
Brace your stomach and step back.
Squat with your knees following your toes.
Drive up through your whole foot.

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit with your back flat on the pad and feet shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower until your knees are around 90 degrees.
Press up without locking your knees hard.
mistakes: Letting your lower back lift off the pad

name: Leg Extensions
steps: Line your knees up with the machine's pivot.
Sit tall and hold the handles.
Straighten your legs.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Lunges
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Take a long step forward.
Lower your back knee towards the floor.
Push through your front foot to return.
mistakes: Letting your front knee cave in

name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward and lower your back knee.
Push through your front foot.
Step into the next lunge.

name: Dumbbell Step Ups
steps: Stand facing a bench with dumbbells at your sides.
Put your whole foot on the bench.
Step up by pushing through that foot.
Step down slowly.

name: Split Squat with Dumbbells
steps: Stand in a long split stance.
Lower straight down.
Keep your chest up.
Push up through your front foot.

name: Squats - With Bands
steps: Stand on the band and hold it at your shoulders.
Sit your hips back.
Keep your chest up.
Stand up.

name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold the bar at your thighs with a slight knee bend.
Push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.

name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
steps: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back with a slight knee bend.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Stand up tall.

name: Lying Leg Curls
steps: Lie face down with the pad above your heels.
Keep your hips down.
Curl your heels towards you.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit with the pad behind your lower legs.
Secure the thigh pad.
Curl your heels under you.
Return slowly.

name: Band Good Morning
steps: Stand on the band with it over your shoulders.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch.
Stand up tall.

name: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Grip it and brace with a flat back.
Stand up by pushing the floor away.
Lower it with control.

name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Push through your heels.
Lift your hips and squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor.
Lift the other leg.
Raise your hips.
Lower slowly.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench with the bar over your hips.
Plant your feet.
Drive your hips up.
Lower with control.

name: Hip Lift with Band
steps: Lie on your back with a band across your hips.
Push through your heels.
Lift your hips.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Calf Raises
steps: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Rise up onto your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Calf Press
steps: Set the balls of your feet on the platform.
Press through your toes.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Rise onto your toes.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

name: Barbell Shrug
steps: Hold the bar in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

name: Plank
steps: Rest on your forearms and toes.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Squeeze your stomach and glutes.
Breathe steadily and hold.

name: Crunches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Tighten your stomach.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit and lean back slightly.
Lift your feet if you can.
Turn your shoulders side to side.
Keep your stomach tight.

name: Oblique Crunches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent to one side.
Curl your shoulders up.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides.

name: Cable Crunch
steps: Kneel below a high pulley holding the rope.
Keep your hips still.
Curl your ribs towards your hips.
Return slowly.

name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on a bench and hold the sides.
Keep your legs nearly straight.
Raise them to hip height.
Lower slowly.

name: Walking, Treadmill
steps: Start at a comfortable speed.
Stand tall and let go of the rails when you feel steady.
Build to a pace that makes you breathe harder.
Slow down for the last minute.
mistakes: Holding the rails the whole time

name: Bicycling, Stationary
steps: Set the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom.
Start at an easy resistance.
Keep a steady pace.
Ease off for the last minute.

name: Rowing, Stationary
steps: Strap in your feet.
Push with your legs first.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Return in reverse order.

name: Elliptical Trainer
steps: Step on and hold the handles.
Start at an easy pace.
Keep your whole foot on the pedal.
Slow down for the last minute.
